titulo: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
resumo_original: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

titulo: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
resumo_original: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

titulo: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

titulo: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
resumo_original: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.

titulo: Sources: Vulcan launch anomaly investigation is complex
